Mixed_Hydrologic_Response_Unit.description: Mixed hydrologic response unit with an infiltrating catchment, an impervious catchment, two surface-routing reaches, a three-layer unsaturated profile, and groundwater for baseflow.
Mixed_Hydrologic_Response_Unit.helptext: A mixed-land-surface HRU for GIS-derived area fractions. Total HRU area is partitioned by impervious_fraction. Catchment receives area*(1-impervious_fraction) and remains coupled to Soil_1, Soil_2, Soil_3 and Groundwater. Impervious_Catchment receives area*impervious_fraction and has no infiltration, soil, or groundwater connection. Each surface drains through its own Trapezoidal Channel Segment used for local surface-runoff routing. Groundwater is intentionally left as an external connection so GIStoOHQ can connect it to the actual watershed reach and represent groundwater discharge/baseflow separately from direct surface runoff.

area.description: Total plan area of the mixed hydrologic response unit
area.helptext: Total HRU area before land-surface partitioning. Catchment, soils and groundwater receive the non-impervious fraction; Impervious_Catchment receives the impervious fraction.

impervious_fraction.description: Impervious fraction of the HRU plan area
impervious_fraction.warningmessage: For the mixed HRU, impervious_fraction must be greater than 0 and less than 1. Use the original HRU for a fully non-impervious unit and a dedicated impervious HRU for a fully impervious unit.
impervious_fraction.helptext: GIS-derived fraction of the total HRU area assigned to Impervious_Catchment. This mixed component is intended only for 0 < impervious_fraction < 1. The remaining fraction, 1-impervious_fraction, is assigned to Catchment, the soil profile, groundwater, and recharge interface.

recharge_K.description: Hydraulic conductivity of the soil-aquifer interface
recharge_K.warningmessage: The interface hydraulic conductivity must be positive!
recharge_K.helptext: Governs recharge from the bottom soil layer into the groundwater cell. Set it equal to K_sat for a homogeneous profile, or lower it to represent a clogging layer or aquitard at the water table.

surface_elevation.helptext: Datum for the whole column. Every bottom elevation below is measured down from here.

depth_to_groundwater.description: Depth from the ground surface to the water table
depth_to_groundwater.warningmessage: The depth to groundwater must be positive!
depth_to_groundwater.helptext: Total thickness of the unsaturated profile. It is split between the three layers in a 1:2:4 ratio, so they are one seventh, two sevenths and four sevenths of this value.

groundwater_thickness.warningmessage: The groundwater thickness must be positive!
groundwater_thickness.helptext: Saturated thickness below the water table. Its bottom elevation is the surface elevation less the depth to groundwater less this thickness.

Evapotranspiration.helptext: Applied to the uppermost soil layer only; the deeper layers and the groundwater cell are not subject to evapotranspiration.

catchment_width.description: Overland flow width of the catchment

manning_coefficient.description: Manning roughness coefficient of the infiltrating catchment surface
manning_coefficient.warningmessage: The Manning coefficient must be positive!

depression_storage.description: Depression storage depth of the infiltrating catchment surface

runoff_coefficient.helptext: Fixed at 1 for both catchments. GIS imperviousness is represented by area partitioning rather than by runoff coefficient. On Catchment, infiltration is represented explicitly through the surfacewater_to_soil_link and subsequent soil/groundwater processes. On Impervious_Catchment, there is no infiltration link.

K_sat.description: Saturated hydraulic conductivity of the soil profile
K_sat.warningmessage: The saturated hydraulic conductivity must be positive!
K_sat.helptext: Shared by all three layers: they discretise one soil profile rather than representing different materials.

alpha_vG.description: van Genuchten ~alpha of the soil profile
alpha_vG.warningmessage: van Genuchten alpha must be positive!

n_vG.description: van Genuchten n of the soil profile
n_vG.warningmessage: van Genuchten n must be greater than 1!

theta_sat.description: Saturated moisture content of the soil profile
theta_sat.warningmessage: Saturated moisture content must be greater than 0 and no greater than 1.

theta_res.description: Residual moisture content of the soil profile
theta_res.warningmessage: Residual moisture content must be nonnegative and less than saturated moisture content.

soil_specific_storage.description: Specific storage of the soil profile
soil_specific_storage.warningmessage: Soil specific storage must be positive.

initial_moisture_content.description: Initial moisture content of the soil layers
initial_moisture_content.helptext: Initial condition for all three layers. Each layer's initial storage follows from its own area, thickness and this value.
initial_moisture_content.warningmessage: Initial soil moisture content must lie between residual and saturated moisture contents.

groundwater_K.description: Hydraulic conductivity of the groundwater cell
groundwater_K.warningmessage: The hydraulic conductivity must be positive!

groundwater_porosity.warningmessage: Groundwater porosity must be greater than 0 and no greater than 1.

groundwater_specific_storage.description: Specific storage of the groundwater cell
groundwater_specific_storage.warningmessage: Groundwater specific storage must be positive.

initial_groundwater_moisture_content.description: Initial moisture content of the groundwater cell
initial_groundwater_moisture_content.helptext: Initial groundwater moisture content. The default equals the default groundwater porosity (0.4), giving a saturated initial condition and placing the groundwater head at the top of the cell under the confined formulation. Groundwater is exposed externally so GIStoOHQ can connect it to the watershed reach as a baseflow source.
initial_groundwater_moisture_content.warningmessage: Initial groundwater moisture content must be nonnegative and cannot exceed groundwater porosity.

impervious_manning_coefficient.description: Manning roughness coefficient of the impervious catchment surface
impervious_manning_coefficient.warningmessage: The Manning coefficient must be positive!

impervious_depression_storage.description: Depression storage depth of the impervious catchment surface
impervious_depression_storage.warningmessage: Impervious depression storage must be nonnegative.

reach_base_width.description: Base width of the two internal routing reaches
reach_base_width.warningmessage: Reach base width must be positive!

reach_side_slope.description: Side slope of the two internal routing reaches
reach_side_slope.warningmessage: Reach side slope must be positive!

reach_manning_coefficient.description: Manning roughness coefficient of the two internal routing reaches
reach_manning_coefficient.warningmessage: Reach Manning coefficient must be positive!

reach_length.description: Length of the two internal routing reaches

initial_reach_depth.description: Initial water depth in the two internal routing reaches
initial_reach_depth.warningmessage: Initial reach depth must be non-negative!

impervious_reach_base_width.description: Base width of the internal impervious routing reach
impervious_reach_base_width.warningmessage: Impervious reach base width must be positive!

impervious_reach_side_slope.description: Side slope of the internal impervious routing reach
impervious_reach_side_slope.warningmessage: Impervious reach side slope must be positive!

impervious_reach_manning_coefficient.description: Manning roughness coefficient of the internal impervious routing reach
impervious_reach_manning_coefficient.warningmessage: Impervious reach Manning coefficient must be positive!

impervious_reach_length.description: Length of the internal impervious routing reach
impervious_reach_length.warningmessage: Impervious reach length must be positive!

initial_impervious_reach_depth.description: Initial water depth in the internal impervious routing reach
initial_impervious_reach_depth.warningmessage: Initial impervious reach depth must be nonnegative!
